title: The Midnight Garden
author: Sebastian Joubert
blurb: Emrys Thornbury, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
